The '''Togorian heavy cruiser''' was a type of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

==Characteristics==
The ship class was shaped like a bird of prey and colored red. An arsenal was located somewhere inside the vessel and it had a protruding bridge. The ship type could attach itself to a target ship and allow pirate boarding parties to enter. The Togorian heavy cruiser was armed with some kind of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannon and used a shielding system that did not hug the hull.<ref name="JA:TRF" />

==History==
Five pirate [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruisers]] attacked the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-run [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Monument (freighter)|''Monument'']] in [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], then on his way to [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] for assignment to the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], his future master, fought against the raiders.<ref name="JA:TRF" />
